options.vitrail.crash_graphics_api_toolt:
Graphics used after a launch that did not finish.
"Vulkan" keeps shader packs. "OpenGL" draws none. "Game default" is the game's rescue.
options.vitrail.shadow_distance_tooltip:
Terrain and entities past this range cast no shadow.
Lower is faster. "Off" skips the shadow map.
Applies at once. No pack reload.
options.vitrail.shadow_distance_forced: This pack already set a shadow distance. The slider cannot move.
options.vitrail.shadow_map_scale_tooltip:
Share of the pack's shadow map that is actually drawn.
Lower is faster, and edges get softer or coarser. "100%" is what the pack asked for.
Reloads the pack.
options.vitrail.render_scale_tooltip:
Resolution the world is drawn at, as a share of the window.
Lower is faster. AMD FSR 1.0 then fills the window. The interface stays sharp.
Applies at the next frame. No pack reload.
options.vitrail.temporal_fold_tooltip:
Folds several upscaled frames into one, so a lower Render Scale keeps more detail.
Distant leaves and fences stop crawling. Things that move keep a faint trail.
Needs a Render Scale under 100%.
Applies at the next frame. No pack reload.
options.vitrail.shadow_amortisation_tool:
How many frames the shadow map is kept before it is drawn again.
Higher is faster: drawing it is the most expensive pass of the frame.
Only the GROUND ages: a block you place or break keeps its old shadow that long.
Applies at the next frame. No pack reload.
options.vitrail.module_cache_ceiling_too:
How much compiled-shader disk this engine may keep.
"512 MiB" is what it ships. Lower drops unused units sooner.
Applies at once. No pack reload.
options.vitrail.compile_card_tooltip:
Shows the Vitrail mark and "Compiling shaders..." in the top-left corner while a pack compiles.
Off hides the corner. The F3 screen still says it.
Applies at once.

options.wynnvitrail.glintBrightness.tool: Controls the brightness of Wynncraft glint effects. Lower values dim effects in bright areas, higher values let them shine through.
options.wynnvitrail.tintBrightness.toolt: Controls the brightness of Wynncraft armor/weapon tints (color recolors). Adjust if tints appear too bright or too dim.
options.wynnvitrail.wynncraftSceneDarken: Controls how much the scene fog and lighting is darkened when a Wynncraft dark skybox is active (Stormy, War, Red Lightning). At 100%, full darkening. At 0%, no darkening. Disabled during rain.
options.wynnvitrail.wynncraftEntityBrigh: Controls the brightness boost for non-emissive entities when a Wynncraft dark skybox is active. Emissive entities are excluded because Entity Emissivity controls them separately.
options.wynnvitrail.wynncraftEntityEmiss: Controls the brightness of Wynncraft emissive entities (rift structures, decorations marked as emissive). At 100%, entities are fully bright. At 0%, normal shader pack lighting applies.
options.wynnvitrail.wynncraftNightVision: When enabled, the entity brightness boost from dark skyboxes is disabled while the Night Vision potion effect is active. Turn off if you want the boost to apply regardless of night vision.
options.wynnvitrail.wynncraftTextBrightn: Keeps text display entities readable in dark areas by applying a minimum light level without changing their colors.
Sets the minimum light level for text display entities when Text Brightness Floor is enabled. Lower values preserve darker ambience; higher values improve readability.
options.wynnvitrail.wynncraftMistWoodsFo: Enables the close fog effect in the Mist Woods area of Fruma, matching the vanilla Wynncraft experience. Disable if you prefer to see further in the Mist Woods.
Controls how thick the Mist Woods fog is. At 100%, matches vanilla Wynncraft. At 0%, the fog has no visual effect. Only active when Mist Woods Fog is enabled.

Sets a minimum distance for the fog to fully engulf. At Default, uses the biome's natural fog distance (about 56 blocks). Higher values push the fog further away while preserving its thickness, letting you see more of the Mist Woods. Only active when Mist Woods Fog is enabled.
Reduces the orange/red tint the fog gets when looking toward the sun at sunrise/sunset. Inverts vanilla's directional tint math for a precise result. Use the slider to control the strength.
How strongly to remove the vanilla sun tint from the Mist Woods fog. At 100% the fog uses the biome's pure base color regardless of view direction. Only active when Reduce Sun Tint is enabled.
